body:
**Handoff from MMR-43 (setup screen).**

- **The vocabulary exists.** `src/MNBL.ProceduralWorld/Generation/GenerationErrors.cs` defines the eight categories this ticket names: missing tool or DLC, incompatible build, refused recipe, exhausted quality attempts, disk full, bad source, runtime capability failure, interrupted generation.
  - Each category has a localisable `{=mnbl_err_*}` title and action.
  - The rule: messages name only what a player can act on; producer codes, executable names, paths and hashes go to `Detail`, which only the diagnostics view shows.
  - `GenerationErrors.Host` covers War Sails missing or disabled, game and War Sails versions, and generator binaries (IO errors included).
  - `GenerationErrors.FromGeneration` maps any unknown status to bad source, never to success.
  - **Adopt and extend this file** rather than defining a second vocabulary. MMR-43 needed it first.
- **Staging cleanup is partly in place.** The setup releases its own jobs (`InterimGenerationRunner.Release`): one job directory under `SubModule.Store/jobs`, plus its heightfield marker, deleted off the engine thread. Developer generations and older job directories are not touched; general staging cleanup, logs, recovery and correlation ids are yours.
